description: PAID $0.08 USDC. One hack/exploit incident brief: fund_flow trail (hops, chains, bridges, mixers, exchange deposits), recovery_status (none/partial/full/frozen/returned with USD amounts), attacker_attribution (only when publicly sourced, else null), severity_score 0-100 with a published formula, and related law-enforcement / sanctions actions with links. Incidents: binance-2026, mercado-bitcoin-2026, luxor-commander-2026, bybit-2025, ronin-2022, euler-2023.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

incident.description: Incident id, e.g. binance-2026, mercado-bitcoin-2026, luxor-commander-2026, bybit-2025, ronin-2022, euler-2023. Required.

limit.description: Optional max top hops to return (1-100). Default 25.

name: hack_brief
title: Hack brief: fund flow, recovery, attribution, severity, enforcement actions ($0.08)
